findings.title: No picture of a boat or the canal in the hero

location.description: the whole hero, at every viewport

findings.viewer_experience: People buy this as a holiday, but the visitor sees no boat or water before being asked to search, so the headline carries the whole promise alone. On desktop and widescreen the empty space under the form makes the page look unfinished.

current.value: the hero has only text, the routes list and the form

findings.target: one real photograph of the company's own boats or canal in the hero
findings.fix_direction: Place one real photograph of the company's own boats or canal in the hero. The maker must supply the photograph, because a stock shot does not do the same job.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees one real photograph of a boat or the canal in the hero at the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The lock count in the route rows has no words that say what it means for a hirer

location.description: the detail text of the first route row, "7 nights, 38 locks", and the same detail in the other two rows

findings.viewer_experience: A hirer who has not used locks cannot tell what 38 locks means for the trip.

current.value: "7 nights, 38 locks" with no explanation of the lock count

findings.target: words beside the lock count that say what it means for a hirer, such as the time or effort per lock
findings.fix_direction: Add words that say what the lock count means for a hirer. Only the company has that fact (the time or effort per lock), so the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees words in or beside the route rows that say what the lock count means for a hirer, at the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen viewports.

findings.title: The form card on the tablet is narrower than the column, so its right edge does not line up

location.description: the search form card on the tablet, between the lead and the routes list

findings.viewer_experience: The card is about 440 px wide while the lead and the routes list above and below it are 600 px wide. The card stops short of the column edge and leaves a strip of empty space at the right.

current.value: card about 440 px wide, column 600 px wide

findings.target: the card is the same width as the column, so the right edges line up
findings.fix_direction: Make the card the same width as the column so the right edges line up.

closed_when.check: A fresh critic sees the right edge of the form card line up with the right edge of the lead and the routes list in the tablet viewport.
